definitions.explanation: The traditional art of writing characters with brush and ink, emphasizing beauty and artistic expression.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{書道|しょどう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: My grandmother is a calligraphy teacher.

examples.japanese: {書道|しょどう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{伝統|でんとう}→伝統：09585_dentou⟧⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: Calligraphy is one of Japan's traditional cultures.

examples.japanese: {書道|しょどう}⟦{展|てん}→展：noentry⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{入賞|にゅうしょう}→入賞：11670_nyuushou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I won a prize at the calligraphy exhibition.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
{書道|しょどう} is one of the traditional Japanese arts, along with ⟦{茶道|さどう}→茶道：04451_sadou⟧ (tea ceremony) and ⟦{華道|かどう}→華道：04450_kadou⟧ (flower arrangement). The "⟦{道|どう}→道：noentry⟧" (way/path) indicates it is considered a discipline for personal cultivation.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{習字|しゅうじ}→習字：04176_shuuji⟧ - penmanship, learning to write (school subject focus)
- {書道|しょどう} - calligraphy as art form (artistic focus)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {書道|しょどう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{習|なら}う→習う：00479_narau⟧ (to learn calligraphy)
- {書道|しょどう}⟦{家|か}→家：noentry⟧ (calligrapher)
- {書道|しょどう}⟦{展|てん}→展：noentry⟧ (calligraphy exhibition)
- {書道|しょどう}⟦{教室|きょうしつ}→教室：00794_kyoushitsu⟧ (calligraphy class)
